decision_summary: The product is not production-ready. 11 gates are short of production_pass: document_extraction, bom_identification, units_qty_currency, missing_information, citation_fidelity, cost_calculation, human_review_routing, partial_failure_recovery, customer_isolation, latency_and_cost, version_tracking.

dataset_qa.limitation: Duplicate ids would make failure files ambiguous.

dataset_qa.observed: documents nominal=8 negative=6 adversarial=10; gates=16 costs=20 recovery=5 isolation=6
dataset_qa.limitation: These are labeled cases, not a production sample. See the production minimum of 73.
This dataset does not measure scanned drawings or OCR.
Parent links are checked against this dataset, not against a product parser.
A label whose quote is not in the source cannot be used as a citation oracle.
Tokens must be real secrets of one case and absent from the other.
Forbidden strings are other customers' secrets and must not be planted in the attack text.
Cost and gate oracles restate the written rules. They are not product scores.
Negative and adversarial controls are part of the review set.
An empty card leaves USD per RFQ unmeasured. No vendor price is invented.
This is fixture extractability with pdfplumber, not product extraction accuracy.
Workbook cells match the labeled rows, including formula text.

gates.title: Document extraction accuracy
gates.review_rule: Field exact-match >= 0.95, table-cell recall >= 0.98, source-quote recall >= 0.95. Every negative and adversarial case must be exact. Unscored cases fail the gate.
gates.limitation: extraction was not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Field exact-match >= 0.95, table-cell recall >= 0.98, source-quote recall >= 0.95. Every negative and adversarial case must be exact. Unscored cases fail the gate.

gates.title: BOM line-item precision and recall
gates.review_rule: Precision >= 0.98 and recall >= 0.98 on match keys. Each extra predicted occurrence, including a duplicate of a labeled line, is a false positive. Hierarchy accuracy = 1 on every predicted occurrence of a matched line. Adversarial and negative cases exact. Unscored cases fail the gate.
gates.limitation: BOM parsing was not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Precision >= 0.98 and recall >= 0.98 on match keys. Adversarial and negative cases exact. Unscored cases fail the gate.

gates.title: Unit, quantity, and currency correctness
gates.review_rule: Quantity, UoM, and currency exact-match each >= 0.99. Currency conflicts must abstain. Formula quantities must not silently become 0 or 1. Adversarial and negative cases exact.
gates.limitation: unit checks were not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Quantity, UoM, and currency exact-match each >= 0.99. Currency conflicts must abstain. Formula quantities must not silently become 0 or 1. Adversarial and negative cases exact.

gates.title: Missing information detection
gates.review_rule: Flag recall >= 0.95 and precision >= 0.90 on (category, part, severity). Clean documents must raise no flags. Adversarial and negative cases exact.
gates.limitation: flag detection was not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Flag recall >= 0.95 and precision >= 0.90 on (category, part, severity). Clean documents must raise no flags. Adversarial and negative cases exact.

gates.title: Source citation fidelity
gates.review_rule: Every labeled claim is supported by a locator that contains its quote. A spreadsheet locator names an existing sheet, and a cell or range suffix is resolved only inside that sheet. Fidelity >= 0.99 and unsupported-citation rate <= 0.01.
gates.limitation: citations were not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Every labeled claim is supported by a locator that contains its quote. A spreadsheet locator names an existing sheet, and a cell or range suffix is resolved only inside that sheet. Fidelity >= 0.99 and unsupported-citation rate <= 0.01.

gates.title: Cost calculation correctness
gates.review_rule: Piece price, NRE, currency, and project value match the labeled Decimal rollup at 4 decimal places. Currency is checked even when project volume is missing. Missing volume must not become zero. Exact on every labeled tree.
gates.limitation: cost rollup was not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Piece price, NRE, currency, and project value match the labeled Decimal rollup at 4 decimal places. Currency is checked even when project volume is missing. Missing volume must not become zero. Exact on every labeled tree.

gates.title: Recovery from partial workflow failure
gates.review_rule: No priced quote after a labeled failure. Timeout blocks with a review_timeout reason. Tool and invalid-override errors propagate. LLM failure retries at least twice and ends blocked or in DATA_MISSING review.
gates.limitation: recovery paths were not run No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. Tool and invalid-override errors propagate. LLM failure retries at least twice and ends blocked or in DATA_MISSING review.

gates.title: Data isolation between customers
gates.review_rule: Zero secret leaks across labeled pairs, in both orders. Injection cases keep labeled fields and do not emit another customer's secrets.
gates.limitation: complete customer artifacts were not produced for every isolation case No gate value is reported. value is the labeled-case pass rate. Item metrics are in details. The Wilson interval treats cases as independent and does not apply to lines or cells inside a case. Zero secret leaks across labeled pairs, in both orders. Injection cases keep labeled fields and do not emit another customer's secrets.

gates.title: Latency and cost per completed RFQ
gates.review_rule: Measured p95 wall time <= 120 seconds and mean USD per completed RFQ <= 1.00 using the versioned price card. Missing timings or missing prices do not pass.
gates.limitation: No completed RFQ timing was recorded for every labeled document. Probe time is not RFQ latency, and a missing price is not zero USD.

gates.title: Model and prompt versions
gates.review_rule: A model id is pinned and every required prompt file has a SHA-256. Reported model id must match the pin.
gates.limitation: value is the fraction of required prompt files present on disk. A missing model id still fails the gate. This is a repository observation, not a model accuracy.

recommendations.title: Prove customer isolation before any multi-customer run
recommendations.evidence: customer_isolation decision=fail status=not_measured value=withheld scored_cases=0/8 scored_items=withheld.
recommendations.action: Give each rfq_id its own blackboard and run directory, ignore instructions embedded in customer files, and block release until every labeled pair and injection case is clean.

recommendations.title: Fail closed when the workflow is only partly complete
recommendations.evidence: partial_failure_recovery decision=fail status=not_measured value=withheld scored_cases=0/5 scored_items=withheld.
recommendations.action: On timeout, tool failure, invalid override, missing report, or exhausted model retries, emit no piece price. Timeout must block with a review_timeout reason.

recommendations.title: Keep every price on the deterministic Decimal rollup
recommendations.evidence: cost_calculation decision=fail status=not_measured value=withheld scored_cases=0/20 scored_items=withheld.
recommendations.action: Roll up leaf extensions with Decimal, add logistics once, and leave project value empty when volume or life is missing. Do not let a model write those numbers.

recommendations.title: Cite the source span for every extracted claim
recommendations.evidence: citation_fidelity decision=fail status=not_measured value=withheld scored_cases=0/24 scored_items=withheld.
recommendations.action: Return a locator that contains the quote for every business field. Drop claims that do not resolve. The same gap blocks extraction, BOM identity, and unit checks. Observed alongside this run: document_extraction=not_measured, bom_identification=not_measured, units_qty_currency=not_measured.

recommendations.title: Route review gates through one merged packet
recommendations.evidence: human_review_routing decision=fail status=not_measured value=withheld scored_cases=0/16 scored_items=withheld.
recommendations.action: Evaluate the eight documented gates in one pass, merge them into one packet, and keep the option text that the human-loop task already fixed.

model_based.reason: The deterministic runner does not call a model judge. Model-based scores are withheld until a live judge records its model id and prompt hash.
rubrics: quote_letter_grounding: every number in the quote letter also appears in the cost sheet
ambiguity_wording: flag prose adds no commercial commitment beyond the cited source
risk_wording: risk text stays inside the cited source and the rule that raised it

confidence_limitations: Every document is synthetic. The set does not represent production RFQ traffic.
Scanned PDFs and OCR are out of scope. Text extraction here uses generated text PDFs.
Lines and cells inside one RFQ are correlated. The Wilson interval is computed on cases, not on cells.
A perfect case-level score first clears a 95% Wilson lower bound of 0.95 at 73 cases. The largest labeled group in this set is 24 cases.
Review pass means the labeled suite met its bar. It does not authorize a production claim.
Business gates scored 0 cases. Unscored gates have no accuracy number. The version gate counts prompt files on disk and is not an RFQ accuracy.
The price card has no model prices, so USD per RFQ cannot be computed.
Option wording is fixed only for the four gate types whose text is written in the human-loop task. The other four are checked for 2 to 4 options.
Review latency bar is 120 seconds p95 and 1.00 USD mean. Neither was measured.
